faqs.question: Why use /model/nanobana instead of a generic tool page?
faqs.answer: This page is designed for model-led traffic. Instead of forcing visitors to choose a tool family first, it starts with Nano Banana and then expands into the workflows where that model fits best.

faqs.question: Does this page use a different right-side media panel?
faqs.answer: No. The workbench area reuses the same creator-side media panel, so saved items, templates, scene switching, and usage patterns stay consistent with /creator.

faqs.question: Can more models reuse this template?
faqs.answer: Yes. The page is driven by a registry, so adding a new /model/[slug] page is mostly a data task plus any model-specific copy tweaks.
